title: Sr. Full-Stack Engineer (Node/React)
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $4,000 - $5,000 USD


The Ideal Candidate:

Along with our partner, we are seeking a self-driven engineer  who's passionate about using technology to improve healthcare outcomes, and who embodies the values described above.

You’re not just here to write code—you’re here to make things better. You take real ownership, move fast, and care deeply about the impact of your work. Instead of just “closing tickets,” you ask questions, challenge assumptions, and look for smarter ways to solve problems  that matter. You connect what you build to business outcomes —like improving patient care, speeding up clinical workflows, or scaling global access to healthcare. You love diving into the unknown, learning fast, and collaborating as an equal partner across design, product, and AI teams. If you get energy from ownership, curiosity, and building for impact, you’ll feel right at home here.


What You'll Work On:

  • AI-Powered Healthcare Products:  You will build and scale their AI symptom checker (10M+ MAU in US/Japan), Doctor's Note, Checkup monitoring tools, and LLM-powered services for both consumers and healthcare providers.
  • Healthcare SaaS for HCPs:  Design and launch new SaaS products for healthcare providers (HCPs), enabling improved clinical workflows, patient data insights, and AI-assisted decision support.
  • LLM-Native Environment:  Operate in an LLM-native product environment, where LLMs are deeply integrated across consumer- and provider-facing products as well as into the development process itself (AI-assisted coding, automated testing, knowledge retrieval, and experimentation).
  • Full-Stack & LLM Development:  Work across frontend (React, Next.js, React Native), backend (Node.js, TypeScript), and infrastructure layers while integrating LLM capabilities (prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, LangChain/LangGraph orchestration) into user-facing applications.
  • Data-Driven Solutions:  Contribute to data analysis initiatives that directly impact user experience, health outcomes, and provider efficiency by leveraging structured (EHR/claims) and unstructured (clinical notes, patient conversations) data.
  • Global Impact:  Develop products that guide millions of users to appropriate healthcare worldwide, while building provider-first solutions that scale across different healthcare systems.


What We're Looking For:

Technical Requirements (Must-Have)

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience
  • Full-stack expertise across all layers:
  • Frontend: React, Next.js
  • Backend: Node.js, TypeScript
  • Database: SQL
  • Data analysis experience - ability to derive insights from user data and metrics
  • Experience building scalable web applications in fast-paced environments
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to code quality
  • Business-level or higher English proficiency
  • At least 4 hours of overlap with NYC time zone (9am-5pm EST)


Nice to Have

  • Experience working in a startup environment
  • SaaS product development experience
  • Experience with AI or LLM-powered product development
  • Healthcare industry experience
  • Experience with global, cross-cultural teams


Our Culture

  • Adaptable:  We thrive in change—experiment quickly, learn constantly, and keep improving.
  • Impact-Oriented:  We focus on work that drives measurable value for users and the business.
  • Ownership-Minded:  We take initiative, think end-to-end, and deeply care about solving real user problems.
  • Humble:  We put mission over ego, embrace feedback, and celebrate shared success.
  • Curious:  We question assumptions, explore bold ideas, and never stop learning.
  • Collaborative:  We build trust through open, candid, and respectful communication.


What Makes This Role Special:

  • Autonomous Organization: Our partner applies Holacracy - no traditional management hierarchy
  • Global Impact: Your code will directly impact millions of users' healthcare decisions
  • Partnership with Tech Giants: They partner with Google to enhance AI capabilities
  • Design Partnership: Collaborate with IDEO/D4V for human-centered design
  • Learning Culture: Work with a cross-functional team spanning multiple time zones


Work Style & Culture:

  • Cross-functional collaboration: Work directly with designers, product owners, and clinical consultants
  • Data-driven decisions: Regular user interviews and metric-based iterations
  • Fast experimentation: Quick prototype → test → learn cycles
  • Direct communication: Open, honest feedback culture
  • Purpose-driven: Every feature connects to our healthcare mission


Tech Stack Details:

Frontend

  • TypeScript
  • React, Next.js
  • Tailwind.css

Backend

  • TypeScript
  • Nest.js
  • GraphQL, Apollo Federation (APIs)

LLM & AI

  • Large language models (Gemini, Claude, GPT, etc)
  • LangChain/LangGraph (backend)
  • Prompt engineering for healthcare

Database & Data Analysis

  • SQL databases (CloudSQL(Postgres)/Spanner/AlloyDB)
  • Redis
  • BigQuery
  • Data analysis tools and frameworks (LightDash/Looker Studio)

Infrastructure

  • GCP
  • Github Enterprise
  • CI/CD pipelines (Github Action / Cloud Build)
  • Monitoring and observability tools (Sentry)

Development Environment

  • VS Code / Cursor
  • Claude Code, Gemini CLI, and Codex for AI-assisted development
  • Collaborative development tools and pair programming


Think you're a match?

  • You naturally take ownership of problems end-to-end
  • You genuinely care about understanding user needs
  • You thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments
  • You want your technical skills to directly impact global health


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to contribute to a global health-tech leader transforming healthcare through AI-powered solutions.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: High Ticket closer
description:
ABOUT US


Property Leads is a premium Pay-Per-Lead company that generates high-quality, inbound, motivated seller leads for real estate investors. We are a team of ambitious, results-driven individuals with bold goals for both our company and our personal growth. While many companies describe themselves as a family, we see ourselves as a high-performance sports team, focused, competitive, and committed to winning.

We're looking for someone who is motivated, friendly, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and is ready to take on challenges head-on.

THE ROLE


We’re hiring a dynamic and driven Sales & Onboarding Specialist to join our growing team. This role is responsible for selling motivated seller leads to both inbound and outbound prospects, managing their pipeline, and serving as a key point of contact in our customer journey.

This is more than just a sales role, as you’ll be the first impression of Property Leads. Professionalism, strong communication skills, great English, and the ability to build rapport quickly are essential. You should be passionate about helping people succeed and eager to grow within a fast-moving organization.

This role is best suited for individuals with at least one year of experience in commission-based sales.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Conduct onboarding calls, schedule new appointments, and nurture leads in the pipeline

  • Manage and optimize our CRM to enhance lead tracking, segmentation, and conversion

  • Analyze lead data and provide actionable insights to improve sales and outreach

  • Ensure timely follow-up and accurate documentation of all client interactions

  • Work closely with the Sales Manager to drive performance and refine processes

    • QUALIFICATIONS

    • 1+ years of commission sales experience

    • Strong

    • 1+ years of CRM management experience, ideally in real estate or lead generation

    • Proficiency in CRM platforms (e.g., GoHighLevel) and Airtable

    • Strong problem-solving skills

    • This role requires strong proficiency in both written and verbal English. You should be comfortable drafting emails, participating in meetings, and handling client interactions.

    • Self-motivated and collaborative with a strong sense of accountability

    • Self-aware and heavy emphasis on constant self-improvement.

    • WHAT WE OFFER

    • Competitive base pay with performance-based bonuses

    • Remote-friendly work environment

    • Clear paths for career advancement and professional development

    • Supportive, high-performing team culture

title: Project Analyst
description:
SMT is a professional services and intelligence company specializing in technologies that transform how companies engage with their customers, employees, communities, and other stakeholders. Together with its partners, SMT implements the most robust global technologies in Experience Management. In today’s digital environment, experience has become increasingly critical for attracting, retaining, and engaging customers, talent, and influencers. Join our team as a Project Analyst and work on technology projects for global leaders!


Your responsibilities will include:

  • Supporting the implementation of the Medallia solution;
  • Training and guiding clients in the use of Medallia services;
  • Configuring and optimizing surveys, dashboards, and automated workflows;
  • Conducting tests to ensure the quality and performance of all deliverables.


What we’re looking for:

  • Bachelor’s degree completed;
  • Fluent English (spoken and written) – mandatory;
  • Strong analytical skills, problem-solving mindset, and eagerness to learn;
  • Passion for data, technology, and user experience;
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to engage with diverse audiences.


What we offer:

  • 100% remote work with flexible hours;
  • CLT contract;
  • Health and dental plan;
  • Life insurance;
  • Flash card (meal & food allowance);
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Financial support for psychotherapy;
  • Access to learning and training platforms;
  • Annual bonus based on performance.


Note: Candidates must be fluent in English; those who are not will be disqualified automatically.

title: QA Engineer – AI-Powered Test Automation - Remote
description:
QA Engineer – AI-Powered Test Automation - Remote


Job Link:


Main Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain automated test suites for full-stack .NET applications using AI-assisted tools;
  • Leverage AI tools (TestRigor, Mabl, GitHub Copilot, including Copilot for Test Automation, etc.) to accelerate test creation and execution;
  • Implement functional, integration, regression, and performance tests to ensure application quality and scalability;
  • Work alongside developers using AI-generated code to validate functionalities and ensure software quality;
  • Participate in code reviews and agile ceremonies (sprints, daily stand-ups, retrospectives);
  • Design and execute continuous testing strategies in CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or similar);
  • Monitor test execution and analyze AI-generated results to quickly identify and resolve issues;
  • Promote a “shift-left” culture to ensure quality from the start of development;
  • Create scripts for load, stress, and security testing to ensure system resilience.

Benefits

  • Work directly with portfolio companies to drive innovation and generate real impact;
  • Leverage cutting-edge AI tools to accelerate full stack development;
  • Be part of a high-performance team within a long-term investment company;
  • Competitive compensation package, benefits, and professional growth opportunities.


Required Knowledge

  • Degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, or related fields;
  • Experience in Software Quality Assurance with a focus on automation (minimum of 3 years);
  • At least 6 months of hands-on experience with AI-based QA tools (e.g., TestRigor, Mabl);
  • Strong knowledge of automation frameworks such as Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, among others;
  • Experience creating automated tests for APIs, databases, and UI;
  • Experience working in agile teams (Scrum/Kanban) and active participation in code reviews;
  • Practical experience integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines;
  • Problem-solving skills and ability to leverage AI to accelerate test creation and debugging;
  • Fluency in English (spoken and written) for communication in a global environment.


Desired Knowledge

  • Knowledge of performance testing (JMeter, k6, or similar);
  • Experience with security testing tools.


Skills

  • Critical thinking and attention to detail;
  • Proactivity in identifying and solving failures;
  • Clear and collaborative communication;
  • Focus on quality from the start;
  • Analytical ability for interpretation;
  • Adaptability to emerging AI tools.

title: Parcerias & Canais (SaaS) – Partner/Channel Manager / Business Development / Alliances
description:
Resumo do cargo

Pessoa responsável por desenvolver e escalar parcerias (agências, consultorias, ISVs/VAR/MSP), criando um motor previsível de geração de receita via white-label, revendas e alianças . Atuação consultiva, relacional e orientada a resultados, com autonomia para testar e ajustar o modelo de canal.

Como terá sucesso no cargo
  • Constrói uma pipeline ativa de parceiros e os leva ao 1º cliente em produção .
  • Cria acordos claros de valor (co-selling/co-delivery) e materiais simples de enablement.
  • Mantém rituais de execução com parceiros (cadência, metas, lições aprendidas) e melhora o funil continuamente.
  • Colabora com Produto, Implantação e Comercial para remover bloqueios e acelerar go-live.
Como o cargo se encaixa na organização

Reporta ao(s) fundador(es) e trabalha transversalmente com Produto , Implantação/CS e Vendas , sendo peça-chave da nossa estratégia de Go-to-Market via ecossistema .

Responsabilidades
  • Prospecção e qualificação de parceiros por vertical (agências, consultorias, integradores, ISVs/VAR/MSP).
  • Negociação e formalização de acordos de parceria (objetivos, incentivos, ritos e critérios de sucesso).
  • Enablement de canal : criação de one-pagers, decks, playbooks e sessões de capacitação.
  • Orquestração de co-selling e co-delivery até o 1º cliente em produção de cada parceiro.
  • Gestão de pipeline e previsibilidade : registro em CRM, acompanhamento de indicadores e feedback contínuo.
  • Cocriação com Produto : retorno estruturado sobre demandas do canal e oportunidades por vertical.
Qualificações
  • Experiência prévia em Parcerias/Channel/Alliances/Business Development em SaaS ou serviços tecnológicos (ou repertório equivalente).
  • Comunicação clara (oral e escrita), capacidade de síntese executiva e construção de relacionamentos de confiança.
  • Organização e disciplina de CRM ; familiaridade com termos de canal (white-label, reseller, ISV/OEM, VAR/MSP, enablement).
  • Vontade de aprender sobre automação e agentes de IA ; não é necessário programar.
  • Disponibilidade remota (carga flexível, preferência manhã).

  • Orquestração de co-selling e co-delivery até o 1º cliente em produção de cada parceiro.
  • Gestão de pipeline e previsibilidade : registro em CRM, acompanhamento de indicadores e feedback contínuo.
  • Cocriação com Produto : retorno estruturado sobre demandas do canal e oportunidades por vertical.
Qualificações
  • Experiência prévia em Parcerias/Channel/Alliances/Business Development em SaaS ou serviços tecnológicos (ou repertório equivalente).
  • Comunicação clara (oral e escrita), capacidade de síntese executiva e construção de relacionamentos de confiança.
  • Organização e disciplina de CRM ; familiaridade com termos de canal (white-label, reseller, ISV/OEM, VAR/MSP, enablement).
  • Vontade de aprender sobre automação e agentes de IA ; não é necessário programar.
  • Disponibilidade remota (carga flexível, preferência manhã).

title: Prospecção Comercial / Analista de Novos Negócios
description:
Buscamos um(a) parceiro(a) na área de prospecção e novos negócios para atuar na região Sudeste. Conhece alguém? Indique para nós.


Prospecção Comercial / Analista de Novos Negócios


A Nomad Nation é uma produtora audiovisual que cria conteúdo para marcas, agências e plataformas, com foco em qualidade criativa e eficiência de produção.

Buscamos uma pessoa proativa e comunicativa para atuar na prospecção de novos clientes e oportunidades comerciais na região SUDESTE.


Responsabilidades:

Mapear e identificar leads e potenciais clientes (agências, marcas, estúdios, etc.);

Atualizar e organizar contatos no CRM (Pipedrive, HubSpot ou similar);

Realizar contatos iniciais via e-mail, LinkedIn e telefone;

Marcar reuniões para o time comercial ou de direção apresentar os projetos;

Apoiar a construção de listas segmentadas e relatórios de prospecção.


Requisitos:

Boa comunicação escrita e verbal;

Organização e disciplina no uso de ferramentas digitais;

Interesse pelo mercado de publicidade, audiovisual e branded content;

Desejável experiência com prospecção, vendas B2B ou atendimento comercial.

(Diferencial) Conhecimento de CRM (Pipedrive, HubSpot etc.)


Perfil ideal:

Pessoa curiosa, que gosta de conectar pessoas e marcas, entende o timing comercial e sabe manter follow-ups ativos com leveza e empatia.


Modalidade:

Remoto

trabalho remoto em horário comercial


Remuneração:

PJ + possíveis bônus por metas de reuniões qualificadas.

Benefícios

● Fazer parte de uma empresa brasileira com atuação global no Grupo Arcadea.

● Ambiente colaborativo, ágil e de alta performance, com oportunidades de crescimento e aprendizado contínuo.

title: Analista de Atendimento Cliente | Sala VIP
description:
Sobre a Quero Passagem

Somos um marketplace digital de passagens e viagens com a missão de conectar pessoas a destinos de forma prática, segura e ágil em todo o Brasil. Inovamos constantemente para oferecer a melhor experiência aos nossos clientes, estimulando a criatividade como motor de transformação no setor de turismo.


A Oportunidade

Já pensou em fazer parte de um ambiente dinâmico, que conecta milhares de pessoas ao redor do país? Estamos em busca de um Analista de Atendimento ao Cliente para atuar na nossa Sala VIP , localizada no Terminal Rodoviário Tietê, em São Paulo. Aqui, você será o rosto da Quero Passagem para os nossos viajantes, oferecendo acolhimento, suporte e uma experiência diferenciada antes do embarque. Se você gosta de gente, tem brilho no olhar e paixão por atendimento, queremos te conhecer!


O que você fará?

  • Recepcionar e acolher os clientes da Sala VIP, garantindo um atendimento cortês, empático e eficiente;
  • Fornecer informações detalhadas sobre o funcionamento da Sala VIP , serviços disponíveis, horário de embarque e facilidades locais;
  • Oferecer suporte em dúvidas relacionadas a passagens, remarcações e embarques , buscando sempre soluções ágeis e assertivas;
  • Manter o ambiente organizado e agradável , zelando pela estética e conforto do espaço;
  • Gerenciar o estoque de snacks e bebidas , assegurando o abastecimento e a qualidade dos itens oferecidos;
  • Atuar em parceria com outras áreas da empresa para garantir uma comunicação clara e um atendimento alinhado com os valores da Quero Passagem ;
  • Ter atenção especial a passageiros com necessidades especiais, demonstrando sensibilidade e preparo para oferecer um atendimento acessível.


Requisitos:

title: Product Designer Senior
description:
⚠️ Professional English is a requirement for this role⚠️

⚠️ A challenge will be required ⚠️


About Uitify


Uitify is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


The Opportunity


We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.


The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience;
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on cybersecurity trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements


  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.


Preferred Qualifications


  • Senior experience: 7+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Uitify, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.


How to Apply


If you’re a senior product designer with a passion for solving complex problems in the cybersecurity and SaaS space, we’d love to hear from you. Please send your resume and portfolio to and

title: Customer Success Specialist
description:
Joom Pulse is a data platform that provides analytics and recommendations for marketplace sellers. Its features allow you to review the most profitable products, know the estimated profit of buying directly from the supplier, discover the categories with the greatest growth potential, and explore profitable ways to expand your business. Joom Pulse helps make e-commerce data easy to understand and efficient for all sellers.


Joom Pulse is one of the key businesses of Joom, an international group of e-commerce companies that was founded in 2016 in Latvia. Joom also includes the following businesses: Joom Marketplace, a platform for shopping from all over the world; Onfy, a pharmaceutical marketplace in Germany, and JoomPro, a platform for cross-border wholesale trade. Joom’s offices are located in Latvia, China, Hong Kong, the USA, Germany, Brazil, and Portugal. Joom Group has its HQ in Lisbon, Portugal.


We are looking for a proactive, customer-focused Customer Success Specialist to foster strong client relationships, enhance user satisfaction, and support seamless product adoption and retention.


Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain strong client relationships, ensuring alignment with customer needs
  • Provide fast & full answers to clients’ questions and support for their problems
  • Keep customers informed on new features and best practices to enhance usage
  • Monitor customer engagement and satisfaction to identify upsell and renewal opportunities
  • Lead renewal processes and identify growth opportunities within customer accounts
  • Ensure high retention rate by providing excellent customer success service & support


Requirements

  • 1+ years of experience in customer success management
  • Fluency in Portuguese
  • Advanced communication skills with ability to handle difficult client conversations, build client trust and understand client perspectives
  • Ability to collect, structure, and filter clients’ feedback, and transfer this to the stakeholders as marketing manager, product manager, and other internal teams
  • Hands-on experience with customer retention and nurturing relationships with small and medium businesses
  • Strong analytical skills and data-driven approach
  • Practical use experience of AI tools and quick software learning ability
  • Experience working based on KPIs (SLA, CSAT, Retention, Churn, Refunds) and results-oriented execution


Preferred

  • Good English proficiency and
  • Experience working in a similar Brazilian e-commerce and/or analytical tools’ company


We offer

  • Compensation package: base salary and bonuses
  • PJ employment with a possibility to move to CLT employment later
  • 100% paid sick leave
  • Collaboration with colleagues across Portugal, Brazil, Latvia and China, with opportunities for promotions

title: Meta Media Buyer (Direct Response E-Commerce + Video Editing)
description:
We’re not looking for someone who just follows orders. We want a thinker who can quickly turn new customers into profit. If you’ve profitably scaled DR e-commerce campaigns into 6–7 figures monthly and can edit video ads that convert, this role is about precision, speed, and owning every dollar spent.


What You'll Do

  • Build, manage, and scale Meta campaigns
  • Design and run testing frameworks for creatives, offers, and audiences.
  • Edit and optimize performance-focused ad creatives (UGC cutdowns, product demos, VSL hooks/sequences).

Note: Experience with AI tools for video and image generation is a big plus.

  • Diagnose and solve performance issues across ads, offers, and funnels.
  • Translate numbers into clear insights for copywriters, designers, and strategists.
  • Run campaigns across multiple e-commerce brands simultaneously, each with unique products, funnels, and KPIs.
  • Scale while protecting business metrics: ROAS, ACOS, MER


What We're Looking For

  • Proven record scaling 6–7 figure monthly ad spends profitably on Meta.
  • Experience in video editing for direct response ads (UGC, hooks, VSLs, demo reels).
  • Advanced knowledge of tracking, attribution, and CAPI.
  • Direct response mindset, thinking in hooks, angles, and funnels.
  • Able to tie paid media directly to business outcomes: profitability, cash flow, sustainable scaling.
  • Clear, confident communicator. No jargon, just results.
  • Ownership mentality: proactive, adaptable, accountable.


Red Flags We Avoid

  • Overcomplicated account structures.
  • Obsession with vanity metrics over business outcomes.
  • Excuses or “blaming the algorithm” instead of problem-solving.


If you’re a data-driven strategist who thrives in a performance-driven environment, this is your chance to scale multiple e-commerce brands and own the results.

description:
Role Overview

We’re seeking detail-oriented candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. You’ll read, summarize, and analyze complex content, validate claims through online research, and collaborate with Large Language Models (LLMs) to improve their performance.


Your work will directly contribute to refining cutting-edge AI systems (like Gemini) — no prior AI experience required — a great opportunity to build expertise in the growing field of AI.


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • You will be assisting with screening and training the others need to be Google account users (uses some combination of Gmail, Youtube, Gemini, Search, Photos) willing to use their personal accounts for this eval (can redact any personal information they are not willing to share)


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and Portuguese)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • No AI experience required.
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : Availability of upto 40 hours per week is preferred
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 2 Weeks inital pilot, could extend.
  • This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles


About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L

We’re seeking detail-oriented candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. You’ll read, summarize, and analyze complex content, validate claims through online research, and collaborate with Large Language Models (LLMs) to improve their performance.


Your work will directly contribute to refining cutting-edge AI systems (like Gemini) — no prior AI experience required — a great opportunity to build expertise in the growing field of AI.


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • You will be assisting with screening and training the others need to be Google account users (uses some combination of Gmail, Youtube, Gemini, Search, Photos) willing to use their personal accounts for this eval (can redact any personal information they are not willing to share)


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and Portuguese)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • No AI experience required.
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : Availability of upto 40 hours per week is preferred
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 2 Weeks inital pilot, could extend.
  • This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles


About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L
